text:
Priya: FYI planning to release 'compact-output' update for rn-render on 2026-05-10 01:30 UTC. Draft RN link: https://internal/redwood/rn/compact-output-2026-05-10.md. Canary us-east then eu. Need pin owner + rollback owner.

Omar: I can own pinning. Target image rn-render:v1.16.2-q8. Will stage by 01:00 UTC.

Tess: Ops recommends 10m canary in us-east, then 15m eu-west. Set auto-stop if error_rate > 2% or p95 > baseline*1.3. Fallback: v1.16.0. I'll prep runbook.

Sam: Oncall — paste deploy command so I can add smoke checks. Also request internal blurb for #eng and #support.

DeployBot: deploybot queued rn-render v1.16.2-q8 -> staging. Use:
```
/deploy rn-render --image=v1.16.2-q8 --env=prod --canary=10m --pin=false
```

Priya: RN edits: include explicit rollback command and contact list; call out token delta (~+0.15 tok/op).

Omar: Rollback snippet added:
```
/deploy rn-render --image=v1.16.0 --env=prod --force --reason="rollback: perf regress"
```

Tess: Will post runbook ops-runbooks/rn-render-canary.md and link in RN.

DeployBot: deploy started at 1798765450 (status: canary).

Sam: Smoke tests ok. First 5m: p95 +6%, no 5xx.

Tess: Error rate 0.4% — continuing.

Omar: Canary looks good, expanding to eu-west.

DeployBot: rollout complete at 1798765600 (status: success, rollout 100%).

Priya: Thanks all. Priya will upload final internal blurb and hold external blast until 02:00 UTC for post-rollout verification. If issues, run rollback above and ping #eng-oncall.
